summary: Yesway, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into several agreements in connection with its initial public offering (IPO) of Class A common stock, including a Tax Receivable Agreement, an amended LLC agreement, a Stockholders Agreement, and a Registration Rights Agreement. The filing also discloses unregistered sales of equity securities: 15,085,561 shares of Class A common stock issued to Blocker Shareholders and 32,009,185 shares of Class B common stock issued to Continuing Equity Owners as consideration for transactions described in the prospectus. This is a routine corporate action related to the IPO and capital structure, not a special situation event.
